[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended task management apps:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Todoist: A highly-rated app with a clean interface, allows task creation, management, setting priorities, and tracking progress.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Trello: A visual project management tool using boards, lists, and cards for organizing tasks.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Asana: A robust task management platform for creating and assigning tasks, setting deadlines, and tracking progress.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. RescueTime: A time management app that tracks how time is spent on devices and provides productivity reports.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Any.do: A user-friendly task management app with task assignment, reminders, and collaboration tools.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Wunderlist: An easy-to-use app for creating and managing to-do lists with reminders and collaboration features.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. ClickUp: An all-in-one project management platform with task management, time tracking, and team collaboration features.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 8. Microsoft To Do: A simple, free task management app from Microsoft that integrates with Outlook and other services.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 9. Evernote: A note-taking app that offers task management features like to-do lists and reminders.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 10. Google Tasks: A basic, free task management app from Google that integrates with Google Calendar and Gmail.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested factors to consider when choosing an app: ease of use, features, customization, accessibility, and cost.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Encouraged user to try out a few apps and explore free trials or tutorials.  
[PREFERENCE] User thinks they will try out Todoist and Trello.
